speaker: customer
text: If this is another investment pitch, I will save you time — we are cutting, not spending.

speaker: agent
text: Understood — I am not here for budget. Can I ask what is driving the cuts?

speaker: customer
text: Board pressure. Everything is numbers this year.

speaker: agent
text: Most CFOs I meet are not actually worried about a programme’s cost. They are worried about being the one who sponsored the programme that did not land. Is that closer to it?

speaker: customer
text: ...That is exactly it. We had an ERP rollout that went badly.

speaker: agent
text: Then let us not discuss a programme at all. What is small enough to test in one quarter — and cheap enough to kill if it disappoints?
